newsitem.title: POLAND: IB Austria upgrades Exbud to "buy".
newsitem.headline: IB Austria upgrades Exbud to "buy".

text.p: Investmentbank Austria upgraded Polish construction firm Exbud SA to buy from long-term buy following the company's successful new issue paving the way for its expansion.

"After the successful completion of the capital increase of PLN 46 million in September, Exbud's strategy to expand has received considerable backing," the report by the research arm of the Vienna-based bank said.

In the report, dated October 21, IB Austria analysts said that Exbud, through acquisitions of construction companies, aimed at strengthening its position as a general contractor and penetrating largest local markets in Poland.
